title: Benchmarking a fast energy model for predicting the stability of solvated surface sites for organic molecular crystals: The paracetamol–water interface

title: Defect-assisted nonradiative recombination and vibrational excitation in the initial photothermal stage of laser ignition
abstract:
Author(s): Yirui Lu, Zeyu Jiang, and Bing Huang
Laser ignition of energetic crystals involves coupled photophysical and chemical processes, beginning with photothermal conversion that transfers photoexcited-carrier energy to lattice vibrations and initiates local heating before decomposition. Here, first-principles calculations elucidate how intr…
[Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 104602] Published Thu Oct 22, 2026
relevance_reason: Uses first-principles DFT calculations on explicit defect-containing crystals to study nonradiative recombination and vibrational excitation, satisfying (a) and (b), and applies atomistic electronic-structure calculations to a photothermal mechanism (c), though not MD.
